# Patterns the licensed guard (.github/ci/licensed-guard.sh) refuses to find
# anywhere under .github/ or in the live legs CI runs. One extended regular
# expression per line, matched case-insensitively. A slug pattern only matches
# as a whole token: letters and digits may not touch it on either side, so
# "_", "-", "/" and spaces count as separators (WPMCP_LIVE_<SLUG> matches).
#
# This file is the only place under .github/ allowed to name them; the guard
# skips it. A new licensed leg in bin/test-local.sh needs its slug added here.
#
# The licensed copies' directory and their path variables.
licensed-plugins
[A-Z0-9_]+_SRC
# Licensed leg names and plugin or theme slugs.
breakdance
avada
